generatedProse.practice-connection: In the School of Sport, writing with argument is how most of your learning is judged. Every essay that asks you to evaluate a training method, every report that interprets your lab or match data, every review that weighs a coaching or policy decision, wants a position held together across paragraphs and supported by sources you have weighed. Treat what follows as being about your own sport essays, reports and reviews, not about writing in the abstract.
